audience: bookkeeping firms and accountants who work with FenoFin administraties

useCases.title: Check the sales invoices of an administratie
useCases.text: List the administraties this key can reach. Then list the sales invoices of one, filtered by status.

useCases.title: Read the trial balance for a financial year
useCases.text: List the financial years of an administratie. Then read the trial balance with one line per ledger account.

useCases.title: Track the budget of a project
useCases.text: List the projects. Then read the fixed price, the invoiced and the remaining amounts of one project.

useCases.title: Look up customers and suppliers
useCases.text: List the customers or the suppliers. Then open one record to read its contact, VAT and KvK data.

useCases.title: Create a customer and a draft sales invoice
useCases.text: Create a customer record, or a draft sales invoice for a customer. FenoFin does not number or send the draft.
